Class PerformanceGenerationStrategy

Namespace
ISILab.AI.Optimization.Populations
Assembly
LBS.dll
An IGenerationStrategy's implementation which takes into account the performance and just keep the last one generations in the population. This strategy is not good for tracking all the generations, for this case use TrackingGenerationStrategy, but is the best one when you have a very long term termination. 
public class PerformanceGenerationStrategy : IGenerationStrategy
